## Description

Replace SQL Server dynamic data masking: the reporting and support role reads only masked views (initials, age band, last four of identifiers as ciphertext length only), has no unwrap right and no write. Tests prove the role sees no clear name, date of birth, contact or identifier.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the reporting role, when it queries a patient view, then identifiers and contact fields are masked.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the reporting role, when it tries a base table, then the database denies it.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
